title: SuperTag Tag manifest
description: A Tag manifest, as supertag apply -f reads it. Its spec is supertag.operator.v1.TagSpec in supertag/operator/v1/resource.proto; this file is generated from it.

name.description: The resource's name, unique within its kind.

TagSpec.description: A Tag's declared configuration, and the `spec` of a `Tag` manifest. Apply merges each list entry by entry: a Role name, a Worker Host ID, a label, a location by provider and scope ID, and a sender Tag.

roles.description: The Roles it holds, by name.

workerHosts.description: The Worker Hosts that may run its Tasks, by ID. An empty pool is valid, but its Tasks are refused until a host is bound. A manifest that lists them is authoritative and unbinds hosts that joined with an Auth Key but are missing.

runsOn.description: Labels a bound Worker Host must carry to run its Tasks; placement only. Labels are lowercased.

execution.description: The harness, models and efforts it allows, overriding its Roles'.

locations.description: Where it answers, each with the sets activated there and the Workspaces its Objectives get.

acceptsMessagesFrom.description: The Tags it accepts Mailbox messages from beyond its Teams, by name.

ExecutionSettings.description: The harness, models and reasoning efforts a Role or Tag allows. A Tag's settings override its Roles' field by field; when several Roles set a field, the first Role by name wins. `execution` is one field to the field manager rules.

harness.description: The one harness Tasks run on, such as `codex` or `claude-code`. Empty allows any harness the Worker Host offers.

model.description: The models allowed; the first is the default. Empty allows any, and uses the Worker Host's default.

effort.description: The efforts allowed; the first is the default. Empty starts Tasks at `low` and allows `medium` and `high`.

TagLocation.description: One place on a collaboration surface where a Tag answers. In a manifest it is `provider` beside that provider's scope fields, such as `provider: slack` with `channelId`. A stored Tag reports the resolved `account` and stable IDs, such as `repo_id` for a GitHub repository.

channelId.description: The channel ID, such as `C0123456789`. Slack IDs are uppercased.

account.description: Selects the Surface Account by its external account ID or manifest name, when the provider has several. Empty selects the provider's only one.

permissionSets.description: Permission Sets activated here, by name.

contextSets.description: Context Sets activated here, by name.

workspaces.description: The Workspaces an Objective created here names, in order. A GitHub location without any gives its Objectives every Workspace whose `source` is that repository.
